title: The heater vent
logline: The Legacy's dash vent, close, a hand held to it in February, the windshield fogged, the pup's breath on the passenger glass. Thirteen years of the same weak heat. The page draws the hand warming.

panels.composition: Close on a station wagon's dashboard vent with a man's hand held to it, the windshield fogged, a small dog's breath-cloud on the passenger window.
